answer: Cosignatures are collected in velvet, verified in pulse, and anchor names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 18 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Repeating the trick 36 times costs 5 separate deposits and 37 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
